column1: # hq code-gate test map: <source-or-glob><TAB><test>[<TAB>timeout=<seconds>]. Rows are sorted (LC_ALL=C) and unique.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. The optional third column sets that TEST's time limit in
# seconds (positive integer; default 120); when several rows name the same test the largest value wins, and the
# CODE_GATE_TIMEOUT environment variable, if set, overrides every map value. See run-mapped-tests.sh / cg_timeout_for.
